title: Specimens Validation Schema
description: Validation schema for records in the specimens tab of the Concrete Grand Challenge Experimental Database submission template.

geometry_id.description: Geometry identifier referencing an entry in the geometry tab.

transverse_reinforcement.description: Indicates presence of transverse reinforcement such as stirrups or ties.

external_reinforcement.description: Indicates presence of externally bonded or externally attached reinforcement systems.

printed_specimen.description: Indicates whether the specimen was produced through additive manufacturing.

notes.description: Additional information describing the specimen configuration, reinforcement arrangement, fabrication procedure, or specimen labeling convention.
